bias.en: Bearish · rally stalled at the Jul 29 low and SAR
bias.zh: 看空 · 反弹受阻于 7 月 29 日低点和 SAR

read.en: ASML rose 6.2% on Nov 9 to $1,513.25, trading $1,468.02–1,525.83. It closed above the falling 5-day ($1,468.62) but below the falling 10-day ($1,540.92), 30-day ($1,662.50) and 100-day ($1,720.90) and the rising 200-day ($1,600.77). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 12 and below zero, histogram narrowing; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 13 ($1,532.31), and RSI is 43.
read.zh: 阿斯麦 11月9日上涨 6.2%，收于 $1,513.25，盘中区间 $1,468.02–1,525.83。收盘站上下行的 5 日均线（$1,468.62），但仍位于下行的 10 日（$1,540.92）、30 日（$1,662.50）和 100 日均线（$1,720.90）以及上行的 200 日均线（$1,600.77）下方。MACD 自 10月12日起位于信号线下方且在零轴下方，柱状图收窄；抛物线 SAR 自 10月13日起看空（$1,532.31），RSI 为 43。

read.en: The rally cleared the $1,441–1,447.5 and $1,471–1,493.5 resistances (Nov 5–6 highs, 5-day, Nov 4 low, Jan 28 high), now support, and stopped under the $1,530.6 Jul 29 low. Resistance is $1,525.8–1,532.3 (Nov 9 high, Jul 29 low, SAR), then $1,540.9–1,547 (10-day, Nov 3 low) and $1,575.6. Support is $1,468–1,479, then $1,441–1,447.5 and $1,409.2. A close above $1,532.3 would target $1,541–1,576; below $1,468, $1,441–1,447.

r.en: Jul 29 low; Nov 9 high $1,525.83; Parabolic SAR $1,532.3
